legend.PASS: Implemented AND proven by an executed command recorded in `evidence`.
legend.FAIL: Implemented but its acceptance check currently fails.
legend.BLOCKED: Cannot proceed until the named blocker clears.

rules: A capability is PASS only with executable evidence: a command that was actually run and its result.
Code existing is never sufficient for PASS. See docs/TESTING.md, Definition of Done.
`evidence.verified_at` must be null whenever status is not PASS.

capabilities.name: Synchronous scoring gateway meets its p99 budget

evidence.result: make verify 11/11 green; 1,360 tests pass (unit+contract+conformance+integration+chaos). POST /v1/transactions over HTTP with authentication, rate limiting, RFC 9457 problems, idempotency and triage. Canonical load gate PASSES at run_id load-20260913-gateway-c86c6cdd on the representative profile against the ADR-0044 topology (noeviction feature store + disposable cache): 499.98 TPS sustained of 500 offered, 0 dropped iterations, p50 1.73 ms and p99 25.30 ms against 20/100 ms budgets, 0 5xx, 0 4xx, 0 429, 0 unparseable over 600 s on a clean tree; 0 feature-state evictions (feature store 548.1 MiB against the memory model's projected 548.0 MiB and a 704 MiB limit); 0 unexpected degradations (299,999 history_incomplete, which a cold store reports by design). Scoring core p50 0.344 ms / p99 0.708 ms. The earlier pass on the single-instance topology (run_id load-20260912-gateway-550789bb) is the measurement that exposed the eviction defect. Report benchmarks/gateway/REPORT.md.

capabilities.name: Redis online feature store

evidence.result: pytest tests/conformance + tests/integration/test_feature_semantics_redis.py: the SAME feature-semantics suite runs unmodified against the naive reference implementation and against Redis, now with completeness declared per test (ADR-0044): an unseen device is 'not known' on a store that has watched for its horizon and 'cannot tell' on one that started an hour ago; an unseen account on a complete store has measured-zero velocity; an empty store is never silently zero. 26 features with declarative semantics; hybrid EXACT/APPROXIMATE distinct storage (ADR-0034). The store writes only what the released features declare, with per-primitive retention derived from the declarations (state_plan.py; tests/unit/test_state_plan.py). Feature state cannot silently evict: the feature store is noeviction and separate from the disposable cache; tests/integration/test_online_store_capacity.py fills a real 2 MB noeviction Redis and proves evicted_keys stays 0, the refusal is typed, and the breaker stays closed. Memory model run_id bench-20260913-memory-model-5c770259: ten-minute working set 548 MiB, limit 704 MiB; steady state 25.82 GiB recorded as an open limitation, not tuned away.

capabilities.notes: PASS stands on its recorded evidence, with a caveat recorded in Phase 3 planning: the online store disagrees with the reference on inputs the conformance suite never supplied (boundary minutes, duplicates, out-of-order arrival, currency scope, future-dated trims), the Redis conformance suite skips in CI, and an unreachable store does not withdraw completeness. Owned by Phase 3 Step 1 (docs/PHASE3_PLAN.md). Phase 3 Step 1b replaced the store's layout to implement ADR-0046; its conformance is tracked by P3.semantics-hardening.

capabilities.name: Declarative rule engine, hot-reloadable

evidence.result: pytest tests/unit/test_rules_*.py + tests/contract: 18 declarative YAML rules over the 26 declared features, one unit test per rule including the abstention path. Kleene three-valued logic (ADR-0033): an absent feature yields UNKNOWN and never FALSE, so a missing input cannot read as 'no risk'; UNKNOWN still settles where a false conjunct or true disjunct decides the outcome. Hot reload is atomic and fail-safe -- an invalid candidate leaves the previous pack in force and increments rule_pack_reload_failed_total. Noisy-OR scoring with band floors that only raise. Validated end to end by the eval-v1 replay: 12 distinct rules fired across 60,000 replayed transactions, R008 among them.

capabilities.name: Redis outage degrades to rules-only, never 5xx

evidence.result: pytest -m chaos tests/chaos/test_redis_down.py: 8 passed against real containers. Pausing the FEATURE store: rules-only, 200 with degraded=true reason redis_unavailable, never 5xx, recovers without restart, and the cache-hosted limiter is NOT blamed. Pausing the CACHE instance: the same transaction gets the same band, score and fired rules -- nothing in the cache decides -- with rate_limit_unavailable reported and redis left 'ok' (ADR-0044). FLUSHALL of the feature store (what a restart with AOF off leaves): the next decision carries history_incomplete, never redis_unavailable and never a clean answer, readiness reports 'warming', and the first write re-establishes the epoch. A full feature store refuses the write and surfaces feature_write_failed without opening the breaker (tests/integration/test_online_store_capacity.py). Postgres loss remains deliberately NOT degraded: 503 and readiness fails (ADR-0035).

capabilities.name: Duplicate transaction_id yields one effect

evidence.result: pytest tests/integration/test_gateway_concurrency.py + test_triage_store.py: two tiers, and the authoritative one is the database. 32 concurrent retries of one logical request against a live gateway open exactly one case, one queue row and one outbox row -- the case that matters, because concurrent retries all miss the Redis replay cache before the first response is stored, leaving cases.trigger_transaction_id UNIQUE as the only thing preventing N investigations. Writing that test found a real defect: open_case minted its own case_id while the caller had already built investigation.requested.v1 with a different one, so every published event named a case that did not exist (191,455 outbox rows, zero matching). The caller's id is now authoritative and the assertion names the case rather than its shape.

capabilities.name: Gateway observation log: every crash, shed and outage loss is a detectable gap
Declared feature semantics pass literal fixtures on every implementation; Phase 2 gates re-met

evidence.command: pytest -m 'conformance or property' tests/conformance && pytest -m integration tests/integration/test_feature_semantics_redis.py tests/integration/test_redis_feature_store.py && pytest -m chaos tests/chaos && make load-gateway
evidence.result: ADR-0046 semantics declared and pinned by literal fixtures in both evaluation modes, with 58 mutants and mode-agreement properties. The Redis store passes every literal fixture as served through one atomic record-and-read script, agrees with the reference on seeded months-long histories and eight concurrent writers, refuses whole when full, and withdraws completeness durably across restarts (chaos). Phase 2 load gate re-met on feature set 2.0.0 with thresholds unchanged: run_id load-20260914-gateway-b43a75ce. Manual replay re-run (benchmarks/gateway/triage-bands.md), and rule re-validation controlled against the Phase 2 commit on an identical store: the only legitimate-traffic regression, R010, is attributed exactly to self-inclusion (eval/replay/attribute_rule_changes.py) and surfaced as U10.

capabilities.notes: Disclosures: one earlier load gate run was refused by the harness (dropped iterations and one timeout-degraded decision) and wrote no record. ADR-0046 is Proposed. U10 decided: R010 stays at >= 5; the eval-v1 delta (+9 legitimate, +3 fraud high-risk, all attributed to self-inclusion) is expected semantic drift, and a threshold study follows on eval-v2. declined_ratio_1h still reads earlier transactions' request-supplied authorization outcomes (ADR-0046 §7, U7). Hot-account scoring cost and memory for the new layout are re-measured in Step 12; the store runs on one Redis instance, and several gateways need Step 4's writer fencing to learn of each other's holes.

A wrong Java, Spark, Delta, Hadoop, Scala or jar fails fast with an actionable message

evidence.command: pytest tests/unit/test_stream_toolchain.py tests/unit/test_doctor.py tests/unit/test_toolchain_consistency.py && JAVA_HOME=$(python scripts/java_home.py) pytest -m stream tests/stream/test_session.py
evidence.result: Unit, no JVM (fake JDKs are real executables printing a JDK version banner): Java 25 refused with the JAVA_HOME fix, and the PATH fallback checked exactly as Spark's launcher resolves it; an installed pip at another version and an uninstalled distribution refused; Hadoop 3.3 and Scala 2.12 jars refused; one flipped bit in a locked jar refused; PYSPARK_SUBMIT_ARGS, SPARK_CONF_DIR and a foreign SPARK_HOME refused before any JVM; every failure listed in one ToolchainMismatchError; doctor FAILs (required) on Java 25 and on missing jars from Phase 3, refuses an unparseable phase, and exits non-zero when run under Java 25; an all-skipped `-m stream` session exits non-zero with the collection-guard message; every pip install in the Makefile, workflows, Dockerfiles and shell scripts is hash-checked or the project's own --no-deps install; every CI job installs from the lock before its tooling; the lock is complete for Linux x86_64, Linux aarch64 and macOS arm64; the gateway's runtime lock is exactly derived from the main lock. Real JVM on Temurin 17: a Spark 4.0.1 session reports Java 17, Scala 2.13.x and Hadoop 3.4.x from the running JVM; Delta's session extension and the Kafka source provider load from the SHA-256-verified jars; a Delta table round-trips at millisecond UTC event time; the Kafka connector resolves with no spark.jars.packages; an invalid cast raises under ANSI; a real installed Temurin 25 is refused in a fresh interpreter before pyspark.sql is imported; a JVM contradicting a pin is stopped and refused after launch. Linux: a hashed install of both locks in python:3.12-slim passes pip check, and the gateway image builds from its hashed runtime lock with pip check clean and no pyspark or pytest inside. Pending: the first GitHub CI run. ADR-0045.
